**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

- **Searched locations:** §§ 2.1 (take-or-pay), 7.1–7.5 (fees/invoicing/disputes), 8.x (term/renewal/uplift), 9.1–9.5 (termination), 10.x (effect of termination), 21.x (liability), 22.x (audit shortfall), 27.3 (force majeure), plus full-text searches for "liquidated", "penalty", "early termination fee", "cancellation charge", "acceleration/immediately due", and "shortfall".
- **Result:** No Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, cancellation charge, or minimum fee on termination exists. § 9.4 caps Customer's exposure on convenience termination to Fees for conforming Services through the termination date plus a refund of prepaid Fees; § 27.3 permits termination "without penalty"; § 7.3 bars interest on amounts found not due.
- **Not double-flagged:** The § 2.1 take-or-pay minimum volume commitment is a commitment quantum, not a liquidated amount or penalty, and sits with the minimum-commitment rule.

No redline proposed, as the clause set already satisfies the preferred position.
